answer.reason: The verses tell of Jesus passing through Jericho and of the blind man who cried out to him as he left.

clauses.english: was entered and passed through by Jesus
clauses.quote: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

clauses.english: was where blind Bartimaeus cried out to Jesus as he left the city
clauses.quote: Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

doubts: The verses do not say the blind men were healed, so no healing is claimed.
The man who went down from Jerusalem to Jericho is in a parable, so it is not counted as an event.
